idea: An integrated multi-signal stock-selection model: established return predictors that carry independent information are combined into one score per stock, which beats holding them as separate portfolios and raises breadth (Sharpe grows with the square root of the number of independent signals) (Grinold and Kahn, fundamental law of active management; Lewellen (2015) CFR; Fitzgibbons, Friedman, Pomorski and Serban (2017) JOI; Green, Hand and Zhang (2017) RFS). This alpha averages 6 such signals whose daily PnL is at most 0.45 correlated, so the combination is stronger and less like any single crowded signal. Missing parts count as neutral so every stock keeps the other parts' views.
rationale_data: rank(atm_call_option_implied_volatility - atm_put_option_implied_volatility): atm_call_option_implied_volatility (option_chart_model): Implied volatility of at-the-money (ATM) call option, measure of expected volatility; atm_put_option_implied_volatility (option_chart_model): Implied volatility for the at-the-money put option.; rank(ts_regression(anl82_netq_deltaprofitability_profitability2, ts_step(1), 63, rettype=2)): anl82_netq_deltaprofitability_profitability2 (analyst82): Profitability measure type 2 based on delta of Q net income; rank(ts_zscore(avg_first_biasfree_price_target_estimate, 63)): avg_first_biasfree_price_target_estimate (biasfree_analyst): The average value of the first bias-free price target estimate for the period.; rank(img30d_return_bisection_prob1_zackbatch): img30d_return_bisection_prob1_zackbatch (chart_cnn_alpha): Model probability from ZackBatch5Pca3 that the 30-day forward return is in the upper half (second bin) of the binary split.; -rank(ts_sum(barra_ustm0_top3000_specific_return, 5) / ts_std_dev(barra_ustm0_top3000_specific_return, 63)): barra_ustm0_top3000_specific_return (pv20): Specific return component for securities in the top 3000 universe as per the Barra model.; trade_when(days_from_last_change(vec_avg(mean_surprise_value_fxadj_revenue_quarterly16)) == 0, rank(vec_avg(mean_surprise_value_fxadj_revenue_quarterly16)), -1): mean_surprise_value_fxadj_revenue_quarterly16 (analyst_consensus): Average surprise value for revenue, adjusted for currency effects.
rationale_operators: rank() puts each signal on the same scale; subtracting 0.5 centres it; add(..., filter=true) averages the parts and counts a missing part as neutral.
